verdict.rationale: Caveman is a CLI, agent and cloud product, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents such an opt-out. The masking and blocking rules cover what reaches a model, and the CLI works without an account; both are adjacent controls, not telemetry opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
